Name: Script Font
Author: bahbahrah
Description:
[size=3]Change the in-game font.
Support only Latin alphabets and some symbols:[/size]

[code]!"# %&'()*+,-./
0123456789:; ?
@ABCDEFGHIJKLMNO
PQRSTUVWXYZ[\]^_
`abcdefghijklmno
pqrstuvwxyz{|}~
[/code]

[font=Georgia][size=5]Compatible:[/size][/font]
May be [u]incompatible[/u] with some UI mods that load the same target.
